balls.text: and Warriors end the innings with a wicket! Rampaul makes room and scoops it straight to long-off, easily takes, close to a front foot no-ball but it's legal
he gets away with a length ball as Gayle swings and can only hammer it straight to long-off
length ball by Dinda and Tiwary tries to clear long-off but mistimes it completely and Marsh runs forward and takes the catch
full and wide outside off and Tiwary gets an outside edge and the fielder at sweeper cover does well to slide and cut it off
this was a touch short and he mistimes the pull to the on side
Gayle adds to his six tally! Dinda errs by bowling length again, Gayle makes room and smashes it over long-off
tries to work it to the on side, ball brushes his body and rolls away
this was a bouncer and the umpires aren't being generous, he will have to bowl that one again
AB gives himself too much room, tries to clear long-off, has to stretch, gets a top edge and Manhas takes the catch behind point, 31 off 8 balls!
guess what...it's another six! Marsh bowls a length ball and AB gets on his knee and slogs him rows back over deep midwicket
Audacious as ever! Another full toss and AB gets right across his stumps and scoops him over fine leg, he plays that shot better than anyone
AB meanwhile's scorching it too, another low full toss, moves across and sweeps him down to deep square leg
drifts on the pads and he clips it down to fine leg
this was short and wide and he nearly lost his balance as he chopped it wide of point
Kumar fires that one full outside off and Gayle stays at the crease and thrashes that to long-off, goes scorching to the rope
tries to go over midwicket but mistimes it to long-on
fires that full and wide outside off and he makes room and crashes it wide of extra cover, Ishwar Pandey dives and misfields, oh well
slower delivery and he cuts wide of point
Gayle overtakes McCullum's record of 158! This is the highest ever individual score in T20! This was short and he swiveled and puled it wide of deep miwicket
that extra ball costs Warriors six more! This was pitched up and AB made himself room and scooped it long and high over wide long-off
Dinda attempts the yorker and AB moves right across his stumps and shovels a low full toss down to deep midwicket
he bangs it in short and he's penalised for the bouncer
it's a full toss and Gayle can only push it straight to long-off, he would have smashed that
follows it up with a good yorker, Gayle drills it back to the bowler

Direct hit and excellent stuff from Dinda! Kohli worked it towards short midwicket and set off, Dinda ran across, picked it up and almost in one motion fired it at the stumps at his end, no need for the third umpire
Dinda bowls length and he is smacked! Kohli stays at the crease, fetches it from the off stump and hammers it over deep midwicket
drifts on the pads and he gives the charge and whips it to deep midwicket
stays back at the crease and he punches him down to long-off
this was full and drifting in on the pads and he whips it down to long-on
this was full and wide outside off and Kohli smashes it straight to cover
on middle and off and he quietly punches this one wide of cover
slower delivery on the pads and he tucks it to mid-on

Gets to 150! Tosses it up and Gayle gets down on his knee and slogs it over deep midwicket. He's just five away from equaling McCullum's record 158, at this same ground. Virat Kohli bends and salutes the big man!
Does the bowler have any options left? This was wide outside off and he slaps it over extra cover
can't get enough! Length delivery on the pads and he bends and mows it over deep midwicket!
bowls that far too wide outside the off stump
outta here! Gives it more air and Gayle gets on his knee and slogs it over long-on, looked like it cleared the roof
take cover! This was bowled flat and he made room and crashed it flat and wide of long-off, just beat the fielder and Gayle was concerned that he had hit someone. He's done that before you know
tossed up and he drives him down to sweeper cover
opens the face of the bat and steers it wide of point to get off the mark
good length outside off and pushed to cover
finally some success for Pune! Dilshan makes a lot of room and tries to carve a length ball over cover, can't clear him and finds Murtaza there
stays on the back foot and he punches it down to long-off
fires that full and wide outside off and he drives this hard past extra cover, bisects two fielders in the deep
fullish delivery and he places it to long-on
on the roof! Can we have the ball back please? Marsh bowls another short one, Gayle pulls and it goes into orbit over deep square leg
punches it to the off side
bowls this one shorter and he swivels and pulls to deep square leg
Gayle swings a bit too early too and misses it completely
Dilshan swings a bit too early and he mistimes it to the on side
wide outside off and he slices it past the infield and the sweeper slides and cuts it off
full and on the pads and he works it to the on side
Wright tries to bowl it short and wide outside off and it's too wide, Gayle doesn't push at it
drifting down the leg side and he swivels and pulls but can't beat fine leg
slower ball down the leg side and he tries to sweep but misses
slower ball worked this time, length ball and steered to the off side
even slower balls don't work! Gayle stayed at the crease and lofted it and for a moment it looked like a mis-hit, nope, went a few rows over long-off
this was shorter and he swishes at thin air, imagine if he connected
on the pads and he quietly punches this one towards mid-on
this was drifting on the body and he tucks it away to fine leg, Dilshan's on 29 off 31 balls, anyone been noticing him?
Gayle's doing it in singles now, cramped for room a bit and he punches it towards cover
slower delivery and he swings this one down to mid-on
slower delivery and he punches it softly to the off side and sets off for a single
this was shorter and he pulls this one to deep square leg
this was drifting on  middle and leg and Dishan slogs and the ball races away to deep midwicket
it's Test match time! Gayle actually shoulders arms and watches it through to the keeper, he needs to catch his breath too
he tucks it down to fine leg
another short one and he pulls this one to deep midwicket
fullish outside off and he gets an inside edge on the drive
this was slightly short and he plays a short-arm pull down to midwicket
fullish in length outside off and he squirts it to the off side
quiet after the storm, he mistimes the pull to the on side

Free Hit: It's out of the stadium! Dinda bowls a friendly full toss, Gayle makes room and clubs it straight, it's the fastest ever IPL hundred, beats Yusuf Pathan's 37-ball ton and Gayle is on his knees! The ball hits the roof
was just going to congratulate Dinda for his excellent bowling and he oversteps! Good yorker, dug out to the off side
this was full again and he squirts it out towards cover
a rare dot ball to Gayle! Yorker outside off and he fails to dig it out
bangs it in short and he swivels and pulls to deep square leg
this was fullish outside off and Dilshan gets forward and times it past the bowler and mid-off, that should bring him some relief
29 off this over! Length ball on middle and he slogs it over wide long-on, he's on 95
full toss would you believe it! Gosh. All too easy for Gayle, those behinddeep  midwicket had to take cover
this is carnage! Finch tries to fire that full on middle and what does Gayle do? Scoop it over the bowler
this goes higher! Flatter one and Gayle stays at the crease and lofts high over long-on, nearly on the roof
Finch isn't spared too! He fires that flat and quick and Gayle gets under the bounce and lofts him high over deep midwicket
inside edge to short fine leg and gayle has to hurry

Pune are appealing for a catch, he fires it flat and Gayle tries to mow it over the on side and gets an inside edge to the boot and it lobs up and the keeper takes the rebound, the third ump takes a look, replays showed the ball hitting the pitch before the boot so Gayle is safe
can anyone keep him quiet! This was flatter from the bowler, Gayle gets on his knee and slogs it flat over long-on
on the pads and he works it to the leg side
comes round the wicket and he sprays it full and he squirts it to long-off
tossed up on the off stump and Gayle gets on his knee and slogs over deep midwicket, no mercy for the left-arm spinner
tossed up and wide outside off and Gayle flashes hard and even an outside edge beats short third man
28 off the last over and not a single run off the bat in this over, tries to smash this past mid-off but can't get it past him
full outside off and he pushes it straight to mid-off
another bouncer but this was high enough to be penalised
good over so far! This was the bouncer and Dilshan backed away in the last minute
all quiet here? Fullish and wide outside off and pushed straight to backward point
a touch full and wide outside off and he pushes it to cover
meaty straight drive but Kumar gets his boot in the way
Gayle's on 50 already and it's a 28-run over! Marsh pitches it up and with a free swing Gayle takes him downtown, down to the sightscreen, 50 off 17 balls
they're coming! Marsh errs by bowling length again, that too a touch too wide outside off, Gayle lofts over the sightscreen
swings across the line and he mistimes it to midwicket
this was the slower ball and still wide outside off, Gayle stays back and moves his back leg across and awkwardly carves it over point
goes the other way this time! This was wide outside off and he comes forward and scoops it over extra cover
the first of many? Marsh bowls a length ball on middle and leg and he lofts through the line and clears long-on
extra bounce this time and he swings across the line and misses it completely
loose shot this time, gets a bit of width and he swishes and misses
this was timed supremely, a touch too wide outside off and his timing and placement past cover and point was impeccable
this was fuller in length and he comes forward and drives and Dinda does well to slide to his left and stops it
stays behind the line and he punches it towards cover
Dinda drifts a bit on the pads and he tucks it away to fine leg
tries another audacious shot but doesn't succeed, the reverse scoop this time but he fails to make contact
cheeky stuff from Dilshan and very clever indeed, it was a low full toss outside off and Dilshan moves across quickly, bends and scoops it towards fine leg
doesn't give him much room and he thumps it straight to cover, quiet over so far
just a touch wide and he stays back and pushes it to the off side
stays behind it and pushes it to the off side
this too was full and wide outside off and he drags it and gets an inside edge
a horrid over comes to an end, this was full and wide outside off, Gayle gets under the bounce and scoops it over mid-off, nearly a six
follows it up with a quick bouncer and he swing and misses
Free Hit: Attempts a yorker but it's a low full toss, Gayle makes some room and swings across the line and it's a four to deep square leg
and it's an overstep too! On the pads and easily flicked away to fine leg
Pandey is on target this time, Gayle stays back at the crease and defends
4.40: poor length and line again, this was shorter and just as wide, stays back and slaps that wide of cover and point
poor start for Pandey, this was full and wide outside off and Gayle simply had to put that away, smashed off the front foot past cover
big inswing for Kumar and Dilshan thuds it down towards mid-off, well timed
this one straightens outside off and left alone
nicely punched away wide of mid-on where Yuvraj slides, just beats the bowler and mid-off runs across and slides and cuts it off
off the mark with a gentle push towards mid-off, good away swing, doesn't hit it too hard
that's a beauty! Beats him outside off, just a hint of away movement, Gayle prods forward
drifts towards the pads and he gently clips it straight to midwicket
well at least Warriors didn't get bowled out! Big heave to the leg side, inside edge, Gayle gives Dinda a big hug, well they're all friends aren't they!
Gangnam Part 2! Gayle spears in the yorker, Pandey made room, and the ball crashes onto middle and leg, the celebrations continue
fires that quicker and the ball hits Pandey's pads and there's an appeal! Missing leg
Gayle does the Gangnam Style! Tossed up and Murtaza comes down the track and misses and Karthik breaks the stumps, the crowd and RCB love it
Murtaza gives him the charge and gets an outside edge that beats slip, Gayle sees the funny side
makes room and he mistimes the heave to midwicket
pushes it towards point for a single

he makes room and tries to carve that over the off side and the ball gets the edge and is taken by the keeper, BK hangs around and the umpire, after ages, gives him out, maybe he was waiting for BK to walk
high full toss and almost on waist height but the umpires are okay with it, RP apologieses to BK
pushes it down towards mid-off
stays back and pushes it to the off side, Warriors going through the motions here
doesn't give him room and he is happy to push it back to the bowler #yawn
bowls it short and he fends it off
length delivery on the pads and he scoops it to the on side and it just falls short of long-on
this was a short one and he made room and nearly scooped it straight to cover
makes room to hammer this over the off side and he misses it completely
keeps it straight and he pushes it back to the bowler
pushes it towards point and Kartik has a shy at the stumps and they take the overthrow
awkwardly played! This was a short ball that BK wasn't ready for, he bent down to evade it and managed to gets some bat on it, top edge clears the keeper
tries to slam it past point but well stopped by the fielder there
bowls it short and he hops and fends it off
timber! Full and straight by Vinay, Marsh stays at the crease and tries to loft over the on side, gets an inside edge and the middle stump is flattened
low full toss outside the off stump and he makes room and fails to put it away
drills a low full toss down to long-off
stops on him and he punches it uppishly down to cover and takes a quick single
drags a full delivery straight to mid-off
RP bowls it too full and wide outside off and Marsh scoops it over extra cover
makes room and he steers it straight to Gayle at backward point
makes room to a full and wide delivery and plays it wide of cover
he drags it short and he stays back and pulls him over deep square leg
makes room to a length delivery and he bends back and steers it to third man
takes a lot of pace off the ball and he swings early and the ball clips his arm and rolls away
he bangs it in short and he swivels and pulls in front of square
keeps it on the stumps and he punches it straight to cover
full outside off and he makes room and slices it over point
short outside off and he tries to upper cut but fails to connect
this one kicks up after pitching and Manhas manages to keep it down and fend it off
low full toss and he drills it down to long-on
Smith tries to pull a length delivery over deep midwicket and he fails to clear the rope, Dilshan gets under it
follows it up with a yorker and the ball goes between Smith's legs
slower delivery from Rampaul and he swings and misses
this was short and Smith plays a tennis forehand to long-on, Bishop says "15-love"
makes room to a full ball and he places it wide of backward point
goes back and across and mistimes the heave to long-on
full and wide outside off and he follows the angle and pushes it towards cover
moves right across his stumps and the ball rolls towards the keeper, take a quick single
slightly short of a length and he pulls him wide of mid-on
stays beside the line and steers it towards sweeper cover
swings across the line and he gets an inside edge to fine leg
fuller delivery and he drives him down to long-on
slower delivery and he goes for a big heave and misses, very close to the off stump
pitched up outside off and drilled down to long-off
full outside off and he pushes it down to long-off
makes room and hammers it down to long-off
pushes it towards cover
tossed up and he chips down the track and lofts him down to long-on
he sweeps him this time and Unadkat slides at long leg and makes a mess of it, the ball rebounds off him and rolls to the rope
from over the wicket and he bowls it too wide outside off
mistimes it and drills it back down the pitch
stays back and punches it towards deep extra cover
slower ball and Marsh tries to smash this and gets an inside edge, the ball spins towards the keeper, Marsh heads back to the crease
this time it's a low full toss and he mistimes it to mid-on
makes room to a length ball and cuts wide of backward point
a bit too short this time and he fetches it from outside off and flat-bats it past midwicket
this was full and wide outside off and he pulls it wide of point
Vinay drags it a bit short and he swivels and pulls wide of midwicket
pushes it towards extra cover and it's the Time Out
drills it down to long-off
outside off and he goes for a big swing and misses, Arun K breaks the stumps and Marsh's foot was just behind the line
tossed up and he pushes it towards long-on
drops it a fraction too short and he clubs it down to deep midwicket
banged in short and Marsh connects really well and bangs it rows over deep midwicket
cut towards point and Gayle - can he do anything wrong tonight - slides and cuts it off and nearly effects a direct hit at the batsman's end
this was dragged short and this time Smith swivels and connects really well, it goes scorching to deep midwicket
gives him width outside off and he swings and gets an inside edge to the keeper
goes for a big slog and he gets an inside edge that just misses the stumps
this was a Hit Me ball - full and wide outside off and he makes room and scoops it over mid-off
he opens the face of the bat and steers it down to backward point
fullish delivery and he pushes it down the track
stays back and slices it down to third man for a single
this was short and Smith plays a forehand and flat-bats it to long-on
stays back and he places it straight to Gayle at backward point
pushes it towards cover
pushes it down to cover point
another top edge, another wicket! Yuvraj makes room and tries to pull in front of square, miscues it and Kohli and Tiwary go for it, Kohli takes it at mid-on and has a word with the fielder
a sharp, short one and Yuvraj swings and gets a top edge that clears the keeper
Wright aims to go big over the on side! He makes room to a length ball and miscues it and AB backpedals at midwicket and takes it easily
on the pads and he works it away down to square leg
Wright makes room early and Rampaul aims to fire that at the stumps, Wright scoops it over long-off
stays back at the crease and punches it to the off side
hurries on to him and he swivels and pulls to midwicket
miscues the pull and gets a top edge and Tiwary runs forward from square leg and decides not to dive, Marsh hurried for pace
drifts down the leg side and wide called
good catch by Kartik! Rampaul fired it full and Finch made room to carve it over the off side, nearly cleared mid-off but Kartik did well to run to his left and time his leap well
on the pads and he tucks it to the on side
makes room and tries to drive a full ball outside off and nearly gets an edge
tucks him up for room and he punches it back to the bowler
tries to play another square cut and he nearly gets an edge, the angle teasing him
lovely shot! Nothing risky about this, this was angling across and he went across and sliced it wide of backward point
Finch tries to slash this one away and he nearly gets an outside edge
well played! Finch makes room early to a length ball and carves it high over extra cover
bowls it short and he swivels and pulls to deep square leg
goes back at the crease and he mistimes the pull to mid-on
Rampaul gives him width outside off and he drives and gets a thick outside edge down to third man
clipped away to the on side and AB runs back from midwicket and slides and his throw is awry, tries to do it all in one motion
good length on middle and off and he punches it to the off side
drifts on the pads and he clips it uppishly down to fine leg
he bowls this one short and he pulls him down to deep midwicket
punches it towards point
tucked him up for room there, looked like the ball came back in and he nearly drags it to the stumps
slightly short outside off and he tries to pull but misses
stays beside the line and he steers it to the off side
a rare defensive shot, bowls it flatter and quicker and he plonks forward and defends
tossed up and he works it to midwicket
tossed up on the pads and Finch does well to get on his knee and sweep him down to deep square leg
oh lovely drive! Tossed up and pitched up on middle and leg and he drills it down to long-on
Uthappa goes the reverse sweep and gets a top edge! Kartik tosses it up, Uthappa tries to get innovative, RP does well to run to his right and take the catch on the fall
stays back and punches it to the off side
